subject: MSA + Order Form preflight: Coupa enrollment, PO ack SLA & tax ID mapping
messages:
From: Sanjay Reddy <sanjay@medbridgehealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Angela Chen <angela.chen@medbridgehealth.com>, procurement@medbridgehealth.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coupa enrollment + Order Form questions

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — team liked the latency and cost profiles. Procurement is starting the Coupa enrollment but ran into two items on the Order Form/MSA preflight:

1) PO acknowledgement SLA — our system requires PO ack within 48 hours. Your Order Form shows 5 business days. Can Redwood accept a 48-hour ack or add an SLA exception for MedBridge?
2) Tax ID and remit address mapping — our Coupa onboarding needs the remit/tax ID to be explicit on the order header to route invoices. The sample Order Form we received doesn't surface a remit/tax field for third-party billing.

I attached the Order Form with inline comments and the Coupa enrollment checklist. Can you loop in legal and ops so we can align and avoid rework during vendor activation?

Thanks,
Sanjay

Attachments: MedBridge_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf (pdf), Coupa_Enrollment_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Reddy <sanjay@medbridgehealth.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2028 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coupa enrollment + Order Form questions

Hi Sanjay — really appreciate the detailed notes (and for flagging the PO ack timing). Looping in Markus (legal) and Kimberly (ops) to propose a path forward. Quick answers while they chime in:

- We typically target 5 business days for signed-order processing. For PO ack, we can evaluate a contract-level exception tied to committed Dedicated capacity or a committed monthly ARR threshold. If MedBridge will be on a reserved plan, that strengthens our ability to provide a 48-hour ack SLA.
- We can ensure remit/tax ID lands on the invoice header and add a field mapping section in the Order Form that Coupa will consume. Ops: Kimberly, can your team confirm what fields we can surface on the order metadata and whether that requires an Order Form amendment?

Next steps: Markus — do you prefer a short amendment to the Order Form wording (PO ack SLA) or adjusting MSA Annex B? We'll need redline language to send back to MedBridge.

Thanks — Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Sanjay Reddy <sanjay@medbridgehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coupa enrollment + Order Form questions

Grace / Kimberly — thanks for the heads up and Sanjay for the comments. Quick legal take:

1) PO acknowledgement SLA — we can offer a 48-hour electronic PO acknowledgement for customers that meet one of the following: a) pre-paid reserved capacity (minimum 3-month commit) or b) settlement of payment terms via a P-card or ACH on file. We should avoid changing core MSA service levels; instead, add a short Order Form addendum that states: "For the term of this Order Form, Redwood will electronically acknowledge POs submitted by Customer within 48 hours provided Customer maintains payment arrangement X or committed capacity Y."

2) Tax ID / Remit mapping — ops needs to ensure the Order Form explicitly exposes a "remit_tax_id" header. That mapping can be captured as an Order Form field and referenced in the Coupa enrollment checklist. No MSA change required; a single-line Order Form field and an Appendix describing field usage is sufficient.

I drafted a suggested amendment and a proposed one-paragraph Order Form appendix (attached). Grace, can you send the draft back to Sanjay with the proposed language and an ask for DocuSign-signable acceptance?

Attachments: MSA-Amendment-proposed.docx

– Markus Klein
Deputy General Counsel | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Reddy <sanjay@medbridgehealth.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2028 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coupa enrollment + Order Form questions

Sanjay / Grace — ops side: we can add two explicit Order Form fields: 
- remit_tax_id (string)
- remit_address (multi-line)

Coupa ingest: MedBridge's Coupa admin will need to map the above to their invoice header. I've attached a short Coupa enrollment checklist marking required fields and who supplies them (Customer vs Redwood). On the PO ack timing, ops can instrument an automated ACK workflow in our onboarding queue to accelerate processing; we'll need a short SLA addendum (Markus's paragraph) to trigger the expedited queue.

Proposed timeline: once legal sign-off on the addendum, ops can enable the expedited ack path and we can complete Coupa enrollment within 3 business days.

Attachments: Coupa_Enrollment_Checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Integrations & Onboarding | Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Reddy <sanjay@medbridgehealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

Date: Sat, 20 Jul 2028 02:08:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Coupa enrollment + Order Form questions

Hi all — this is great, thanks for the fast turnaround. MedBridge is comfortable with the approach:

- We'll commit to a 3-month reserved capacity pilot (finance sign-off in progress) so we can get the 48-hour PO ack SLA in the addendum.
- I'll confirm the remit_tax_id and remit_address values and have our Coupa admin map them to the invoice header.

Request: can you send the redline + one-paragraph addendum as a DocuSign link so procurement can route it through our signature matrix? If possible, include a target effective date (we're hoping to go-live for purchase orders by Aug 1).

Appreciate the help — Sanjay
